headline: Big gift to traders before Dussehra: Indian goods to be sold in New Zealand without paying tax; trade deal finalised
summary: The India-New Zealand free trade agreement will come into force on October 20, according to Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal. He said all Indian exports can reach New Zealand without any duty.
why: Free trade agreements remove tariffs on bilateral goods flows, altering export costs and competitiveness for both economies.
